abstract: The purpose of this study was to describe the rates of cardiovascular and other medical complications related to the use of platinum-based chemotherapy in American testicular cancer survivors. The study sample consisted of 143 eligible long-term testicular cancer survivors. Participants were interviewed, their medical records were reviewed, and blood was obtained for cholesterol measurement during their follow-up visit. The mean follow-up time was 8.4 yr, and their mean age at follow-up was 41.2 yr; 72.7% had had non-seminoma, and 82.5% had received platinum-based chemotherapy. Hypertension rates in the platinum-treated group increased significantly from baseline to follow-up; however, once adjusted for blood pressure measurement (undiagnosed hypertension), no such increase was seen, and hypertension rates were already higher than national estimates at baseline in all groups. At the follow-up visit, the rates of hyperlipidemia (adjusted for measured cholesterol level) in both platinum- and non-platinum-treated groups (28.4% and 37.5%, respectively) were higher than national estimates (16.9%). Rates of coronary artery disease were higher in those who had received platinum and radiation (11.1%) than in those who had received platinum alone (4.3%), but this difference was not statistically significant. As suggested by previous studies, platinum-based chemotherapy may be associated with hypertension, hyperlipidemia, and coronary artery disease. However, our data suggest that undiagnosed hypertension and hyperlipidemia may be significant confounders, and we also observed a trend toward lower testosterone levels in participants who experienced cardiovascular complications.
abstract_ja:
目的：本研究の目的は、米国の精巣がん生存者における白金製剤化学療法に関連する心血管系およびその他の医学的合併症の発生率を記述することである。
方法：適格な長期精巣がん生存者143例を対象とした。参加者への面接、診療記録の確認、フォローアップ時の血中コレステロール測定を行った。平均フォローアップ期間は8.4年、追跡時の平均年齢は41.2歳であった。72.7%が非セミノーマであり、82.5%が白金製剤化学療法を受けていた。
結果：白金製剤化学療法群では、ベースラインからフォローアップ時にかけて高血圧の割合が有意に増加した。しかし未診断の高血圧で補正すると、そのような増加はみられなかった。いずれの群でも高血圧の割合はベースラインですでに全国推定値より高かった。フォローアップ時の高脂血症の割合（コレステロール値で補正後）は、白金製剤群と非白金製剤群でそれぞれ28.4%と37.5%であり、全国推定値（16.9%）より高かった。冠動脈疾患の割合は、白金製剤と放射線療法を受けた群（11.1%）の方が白金製剤のみの群（4.3%）より高かったが、統計学的有意差はなかった。
結論：白金製剤化学療法は高血圧、高脂血症、冠動脈疾患と関連する可能性があるという先行研究と一致する。しかし本研究の結果は、未診断の高血圧と高脂血症が重要な交絡因子となりうることを示唆する。また、心血管合併症を経験した参加者では、テストステロン値が低い傾向が認められた。
